definitions.cpuMs: Renderer process CPU (user + system) through grammar settlement; includes packages/UI/other renderer threads.
definitions.settlementMs: From last insertion return to current grammar and indentation readiness.
definitions.frames: requestAnimationFrame intervals, not physical presentation. Frames arriving after settlement are excluded.
definitions.typing: JS and CRLF Python: 240 commands at 60/s, 120 at 8/s; ABBA.
definitions.control: Supplied SOFiSTiK file, 600 commands at 60/s; ABBA. Private path and contents excluded; file never saved.
definitions.isolated: Synchronous Node parser comparison on generated JS; separate ABBA processes, 4 warmup + 20 measured parses each. Two native comparisons before vs one after; final tree and range hashes checked. Not a renderer benchmark.
definitions.packages: 37 workspace packages activated; not every optional feature exercised. No package sources intentionally changed; no pre-run whole-fleet fingerprint.
definitions.scope: Only comparison selection/ownership and cleanup changed. First two expensive synchronous updates, checkpoint policy and unsafe-resumption fallback unchanged.
